info.title: My Exp API
info.description:
Personal and family expense assistant.

**Authentication:** `POST /auth/google` with the Google ID token returns a
short-lived access token (Bearer) and a refresh token (`POST /auth/refresh`).
With `ENVIRONMENT=development` the `X-Dev-User-Id` header is also accepted.

**Accounts:** all data belongs to an account (`/accounts/{account_id}/...`);
non-members get 404.

**Errors:** `{"detail": "message"}`; validation (422) carries the error list.
429 means rate limited (see `Retry-After`).

post.description:
Exchanges the Google ID token for an API session.

The first login creates the user (or links the invitation with the same e-mail).
DEV ONLY (404 outside development): same tokens as the Google login, by e-mail only.
Issues a new token pair; the refresh token sent is no longer valid.
Ends the current session (or all of them, with `everywhere=true`).

DocumentDetailResponse.title: DocumentDetailResponse
DocumentDetailResponse.description:
Document + what was extracted from it.

The internal processing error is not exposed (it may contain provider/infra
details); `processing_status=failed` is enough for the UI.
